description: Portuguese general searches covered all four weekly windows and targeted 8M, 15M student demonstrations and 22 March teacher actions; English discovery consisted of broad half-month searches only. Additional feasible English local/regional and sector-specific weekly sweeps were not run. Search results include many irrelevant historic pages and do not establish an exhaustive universe.
required_followup: In a permitted follow-up version, run new English searches for undercovered March week windows and local/sector terms; do not repeat the completed broad searches.

description: BRA23M-E002 is confirmed at MASP on 8 March with an extensive policy/rights agenda, but no São Paulo attendance estimate is present. Other capitals are not pooled. Several demands have no clearly identified government addressee beyond the no-amnesty claim.
required_followup: Search a permitted São Paulo local source for the actual count at MASP and a source stating how the local demands were directed to Brazilian policy authorities.

description: BRA23M-E003 is confirmed at Praça da Piedade, Salvador on 22 March with Brazilian education-policy and salary-floor demands, but no site-specific attendee number is reported.
required_followup: Search a permitted Salvador/Bahia local report or public record for a turnout estimate at Praça da Piedade; do not use participation from other cities.

description: Search-only leads report an education-policy gathering in Sergipe and a state-teacher strike/announced rally in Rio de Janeiro on 22 March. The Sergipe snippet says an act took place but gives no count; the Rio report is prospective for the rally after the strike. Neither is an event coded from search-only evidence.
required_followup: Check the exact two local articles with fresh exact-URL assessment before any body request; verify whether each actual public gathering occurred and its own-site attendance. No cross-city pooling.

description: The 15 March Brasilia protest has an explicit same-day dispersion report. No evidence yet links it as a continuing physical episode to the later 22 March education-worker day in Salvador or other cities; issue continuity versus a new action remains a review question.
required_followup: Compare organizers, action calls, dates, participant groups and physical activity in any next-step local sources to assess distinct episodes; do not merge merely because both oppose the New High School policy.

description: For BRA23M-E001, the report says students began dispersing around 11:00, which does not establish complete physical end. Do not code an end date from partial dispersal.
required_followup: Search a permitted same-day retrospective or follow-up account that explicitly reports the event had ended; absent such evidence keep end_date null.
